values.note: 24 sites (15 reservable) plus a group site; 'a good combination of pull-through and back-in sites'. recreation.gov gives driveway lengths of 12-50 ft (003, 017, 024 at 50; 002, 010, 013, 023 at 45; most others 20-27); its Max Vehicle Length field is blank (0) on every site. Some sites (6, 11, 13) lost their shade to hazard-tree removal.

values.note: Two hand-pump water systems; trash service.

values.note: $26 a site (2026-2028 rate tables). On site: exact cash or check only, no credit cards. The FS page notes an approved fee change.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/mbrtb/recreation/seedhouse-campground ('Single Site: $26 per night'; 'Exact cash or check only as there is no option for change back if paying cash. NO CREDIT CARDS accepted.'; 'This site was approved for a fee change') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234552/rates (STANDARD NONELECTRIC $26, 2026-2028), read 2026-10-28

note: Routt NF campground at 8,000 ft, ~25 mi north of Steamboat Springs: CR 129 (Elk River Rd) north ~17-20 mi to just past Clark, then ~9.5 mi up Seedhouse Rd (CR 64 / FR 400) to just past the North Fork bridge. In spruce-fir near the Middle Fork of the Elk River, which can be heard from camp; gateway to the Mount Zirkel Wilderness and a Continental Divide Trail connector. --Claude
summary: FS + recreation.gov: confirmed $26, no hookups, reservable with first-come sites, 50-ft longest driveway. Waterfront 'not waterfront' kept: the North Fork of the Elk River is a ~5-10 m stream in a rocky, tree-lined channel west of the loop (sites 15/16 ~50-80 m away on NAIP), and the Middle Fork is out of sight ('visitors can hear' it). No pad on either bank.
Road: Seedhouse Rd (CR 64 / FR 400) is the standard approach; no RV, 4WD or closure warning on the FS or recreation.gov pages.
Pin 40.771754,-106.772438 is ~17 m from the catalog centroid and ~20 m from the FS coordinates. OK.
